2. 60-SECOND READ: STATE-OPAQUE. Only visible artifact is a 641-byte page; CSS appears as text, no repo, README, tests, CI, commits, docs, metrics, or live app state. Redirect target unverified. Cannot judge size or health.

3. ACTION: Scraped the provided HTML only; did not follow redirect because no live browser/network in this evaluation. In real use: redirect/click, then immediately hunt for repo/tests/commits/status.

4. BOUNCE: “The Tap has moved to a bigger room” plus visible CSS text. Vague marketing and broken presentation = distrust.

5. VERDICT: LEAVE — no receipts, no state, no reason to spend more than 10 seconds unless I already knew The Tap/SuperInstance.

6. ONE FIX: Replace the interstitial with a one-screen status page: what it is, repo URL, latest commit hash/date, CI/test badge, live URL, and why it moved; keep redirect secondary.
